title: BeyondBotsAnnotationSchema
description: Annotation schema for labeling coordinated social media discourse clusters.

cluster_id.description: Unique identifier for the cluster being annotated.

label.description: The initial label assigned to the cluster by the annotator.

annotator_id.description: Unique identifier for the annotator (e.g. name or worker ID).

confidence.description: The annotator's subjective confidence score for the assigned label.

notes.description: Qualitative observations about the cluster's text style, account handles, or temporal patterns.

agreed_label.description: The final consensus label after multi-annotator validation.
